title: Five haiku
author: Randy Brooks
text:
box canyon
the cowhand and his horse
face a cool breeze

•

names of friends
crayoned on paper bags
farmyard apples

•

white out
the only tracks in snow
behind us

•

cherry blossoms long gone
not easy turning
the other cheek

•

backyard croquet
the shell of a cicada
his cheerleader
